item.title: AI for DevOps
item.description: AI is transforming DevOps practices through agentic AI systems that go beyond simple chatbots. These coding agents combine large language models with tools, memory, and planning capabilities to autonomously handle complex Platform Engineering and SRE tasks. By integrating with MCPs (Model Context Protocol), skills, and spec-driven development workflows, agents can create observability systems, build infrastructure APIs, and manage systems with minimal human intervention.
